wake.direction: earlier — do not lock 9–10 as the permanent standard
wake.exception: If up late the night before, waking 9–10 (or later) that morning is OK — don't force early after a late night
wake.flex_rule: Default push toward earlier wake over time. Only slide the day later when the prior night was late. Never treat 9–10 as 'this is who I am forever.'
wake.note: Currently wake 9–10, but Adam does not want to keep it that way unless up late. 6:40 remains aspirational; coach progress toward earlier without shaming today's clock.
